hook: A major crypto exchange just lost 200 million dollars in a devastating hack.
body: The attack exploited a critical flaw in the multisig wallet configuration.
cta: Follow for more crypto security updates.

suggested_visual_beats.name: beat_01_overview
suggested_visual_beats.narration_text: Security researchers at Chainalysis identified the vulnerability in the exchange cold storage setup. The flaw allowed unauthorized signature aggregation.

suggested_visual_beats.name: beat_02_stat
suggested_visual_beats.narration_text: The attacker made off with exactly 347 Bitcoin worth over 200 million dollars.

suggested_visual_beats.name: beat_03_diagram
suggested_visual_beats.narration_text: Normal multisig requires 3 of 5 signatures. The exploit bypassed this by replaying a single signature across all slots.
